posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked:
You are not creating in the correct folder structure. Please watch the video or read the README in your home directory about how to solve assignment inside VM.
The folder structure should be ~/se2001/practice_4.1, not ~/practice_4.1.

Furthermore, to train your debugging ability, observe that the synchro eval command clearly states the issue at hand:

Argument required or current working directory should be solution directory
